migrations.name: initial schema
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE properties (
        id                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name                     TEXT NOT NULL,
        address                  TEXT,
        type                     TEXT,
        size_m2                  INTEGER,
        garage                   INTEGER,                 -- 0/1
        purchase_date            TEXT NOT NULL,           -- ISO yyyy-mm-dd
        purchase_price           TEXT NOT NULL,           -- decimal string
        appreciation_override_pa TEXT,                    -- decimal string, nullable
        rent_index_override_pa   TEXT
      );

      CREATE TABLE mortgage_blocks (
        id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        property_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        start_date         TEXT NOT NULL,
        initial_principal  TEXT NOT NULL,
        fixation_years     INTEGER NOT NULL,
        interest_rate_pa   TEXT NOT NULL,
        monthly_instalment TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE valuations (
        id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        property_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        valid_from   TEXT NOT NULL,
        valid_to     TEXT,                                -- nullable: open-ended
        market_value TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE leases (
        id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        property_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        start_date   TEXT NOT NULL,
        end_date     TEXT,                                -- nullable: current lease
        monthly_rent TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE holding_costs (
        id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        property_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        property_tax_yr TEXT,                             -- all nullable: NULL ⇒ default
        insurance_yr    TEXT,
        mgmt_pct_rent   TEXT,
        maint_pct_rent  TEXT,
        svj_monthly     TEXT,
        other_yr        TEXT
      );

      CREATE TABLE assumptions (
        id                          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),  -- single row
        base_date                   TEXT NOT NULL,
        appreciation_pa             TEXT NOT NULL,
        rent_indexation_pa          TEXT NOT NULL,
        vacancy_allowance           TEXT NOT NULL,
        post_fixation_reset_rate_pa TEXT NOT NULL,
        horizon_years               INTEGER NOT NULL,
        inflation_pa                TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_property_tax_yr     TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_insurance_yr        TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_mgmt_pct_rent       TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_maint_pct_rent      TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_svj_monthly         TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_other_yr            TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE scenarios (
        id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name       TEXT NOT NULL,
        overrides  TEXT NOT NULL,                         -- JSON assumption overrides
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );

migrations.name: constraints (unique natural keys, checks)
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE properties_new (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        address TEXT,
        type TEXT,
        size_m2 INTEGER,
        garage INTEGER,
        purchase_date TEXT NOT NULL,
        purchase_price TEXT NOT NULL,
        appreciation_override_pa TEXT,
        rent_index_override_pa TEXT,
        active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        CONSTRAINT property_purchase_date_iso CHECK (purchase_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT property_purchase_price_not_negative CHECK (purchase_price NOT GLOB '-*'),
        CONSTRAINT property_active_flag CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),
        CONSTRAINT property_garage_flag CHECK (garage IN (0, 1)),
        UNIQUE (name)
      );
      INSERT INTO properties_new (id, name, address, type, size_m2, garage, purchase_date, purchase_price, appreciation_override_pa, rent_index_override_pa, active) SELECT id, name, address, type, size_m2, garage, purchase_date, purchase_price, appreciation_override_pa, rent_index_override_pa, active FROM properties;
      DROP TABLE properties;
      ALTER TABLE properties_new RENAME TO properties;
  

      CREATE TABLE mortgage_blocks_new (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        property_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
        initial_principal TEXT NOT NULL,
        fixation_years INTEGER NOT NULL,
        interest_rate_pa TEXT NOT NULL,
        monthly_instalment TEXT NOT NULL,
        loan_term_years INTEGER,
        draws TEXT,
        interest_only_until TEXT,
        contract_maturity_date TEXT,
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_start_date_iso CHECK (start_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_principal_not_negative CHECK (initial_principal NOT GLOB '-*'),
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_instalment_not_negative CHECK (monthly_instalment NOT GLOB '-*'),
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_rate_0_to_1 CHECK (CAST(interest_rate_pa AS REAL) BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_fixation_whole_years CHECK (typeof(fixation_years) = 'integer' AND fixation_years >= 0),
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_term_positive CHECK (loan_term_years > 0),
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_interest_only_until_iso CHECK (interest_only_until GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_contract_maturity_iso CHECK (contract_maturity_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT mortgage_draws_json CHECK (json_valid(draws)),
        UNIQUE (property_id, start_date)
      );
      INSERT INTO mortgage_blocks_new (id, property_id, start_date, initial_principal, fixation_years, interest_rate_pa, monthly_instalment, loan_term_years, draws, interest_only_until, contract_maturity_date) SELECT id, property_id, start_date, initial_principal, fixation_years, interest_rate_pa, monthly_instalment, loan_term_years, draws, interest_only_until, contract_maturity_date FROM mortgage_blocks;
      DROP TABLE mortgage_blocks;
      ALTER TABLE mortgage_blocks_new RENAME TO mortgage_blocks;
  

      CREATE TABLE valuations_new (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        property_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        valid_from TEXT NOT NULL,
        valid_to TEXT,
        market_value TEXT NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT valuation_valid_from_iso CHECK (valid_from GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT valuation_valid_to_iso CHECK (valid_to GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT valuation_end_not_before_start CHECK (valid_to >= valid_from),
        CONSTRAINT valuation_value_not_negative CHECK (market_value NOT GLOB '-*'),
        UNIQUE (property_id, valid_from)
      );
      INSERT INTO valuations_new (id, property_id, valid_from, valid_to, market_value) SELECT id, property_id, valid_from, valid_to, market_value FROM valuations;
      DROP TABLE valuations;
      ALTER TABLE valuations_new RENAME TO valuations;
  

      CREATE TABLE leases_new (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        property_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
        end_date TEXT,
        monthly_rent TEXT NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT lease_start_date_iso CHECK (start_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT lease_end_date_iso CHECK (end_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT lease_end_not_before_start CHECK (end_date >= start_date),
        CONSTRAINT lease_rent_not_negative CHECK (monthly_rent NOT GLOB '-*'),
        UNIQUE (property_id, start_date)
      );
      INSERT INTO leases_new (id, property_id, start_date, end_date, monthly_rent) SELECT id, property_id, start_date, end_date, monthly_rent FROM leases;
      DROP TABLE leases;
      ALTER TABLE leases_new RENAME TO leases;
  

      CREATE TABLE holding_costs_new (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        property_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        property_tax_yr TEXT,
        insurance_yr TEXT,
        mgmt_pct_rent TEXT,
        maint_pct_rent TEXT,
        svj_monthly TEXT,
        other_yr TEXT,
        UNIQUE (property_id)
      );
      INSERT INTO holding_costs_new (id, property_id, property_tax_yr, insurance_yr, mgmt_pct_rent, maint_pct_rent, svj_monthly, other_yr) SELECT id, property_id, property_tax_yr, insurance_yr, mgmt_pct_rent, maint_pct_rent, svj_monthly, other_yr FROM holding_costs;
      DROP TABLE holding_costs;
      ALTER TABLE holding_costs_new RENAME TO holding_costs;
  

      CREATE TABLE assumptions_new (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
        base_date TEXT NOT NULL,
        appreciation_pa TEXT NOT NULL,
        rent_indexation_pa TEXT NOT NULL,
        vacancy_allowance TEXT NOT NULL,
        post_fixation_reset_rate_pa TEXT NOT NULL,
        horizon_years INTEGER NOT NULL,
        inflation_pa TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_property_tax_yr TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_insurance_yr TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_mgmt_pct_rent TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_maint_pct_rent TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_svj_monthly TEXT NOT NULL,
        default_other_yr TEXT NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT assumptions_base_date_iso CHECK (base_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
        CONSTRAINT assumptions_horizon_positive CHECK (typeof(horizon_years) = 'integer' AND horizon_years > 0),
        CONSTRAINT assumptions_vacancy_0_to_1 CHECK (CAST(vacancy_allowance AS REAL) BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
        CONSTRAINT assumptions_mgmt_0_to_1 CHECK (CAST(default_mgmt_pct_rent AS REAL) BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
        CONSTRAINT assumptions_maint_0_to_1 CHECK (CAST(default_maint_pct_rent AS REAL) BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
      );
      INSERT INTO assumptions_new (id, base_date, appreciation_pa, rent_indexation_pa, vacancy_allowance, post_fixation_reset_rate_pa, horizon_years, inflation_pa, default_property_tax_yr, default_insurance_yr, default_mgmt_pct_rent, default_maint_pct_rent, default_svj_monthly, default_other_yr) SELECT id, base_date, appreciation_pa, rent_indexation_pa, vacancy_allowance, post_fixation_reset_rate_pa, horizon_years, inflation_pa, default_property_tax_yr, default_insurance_yr, default_mgmt_pct_rent, default_maint_pct_rent, default_svj_monthly, default_other_yr FROM assumptions;
      DROP TABLE assumptions;
      ALTER TABLE assumptions_new RENAME TO assumptions;
  

      CREATE TABLE scenarios_new (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        overrides TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT scenario_overrides_json CHECK (json_valid(overrides))
      );
      INSERT INTO scenarios_new (id, name, overrides, created_at) SELECT id, name, overrides, created_at FROM scenarios;
      DROP TABLE scenarios;
      ALTER TABLE scenarios_new RENAME TO scenarios;
